name: Grilli Type · GT Sectra

title.zh: Grilli Type · 先比较字族样张

description.zh: 看Sectra真实字形与三栏部分款式名。 Grilli Type的零售字族目录可比较GT系列字体，GT Sectra详情提供大幅字形和部分款式样张。正式使用按地域EULA与Desktop、Web、App等用途付费；免费试用允许测试及提案，最终作品受限，学生有特定例外。
description.en: Grilli Type’s retail typeface collection includes GT families and concrete specimens such as GT Sectra. Paid use depends on regional agreements and Desktop, Web or App licensing. Free trials permit testing and pitches, with restrictions on final files and a specific educational exception for eligible students.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Grilli Type (https://www.grillitype.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Sectra真实字形与三栏部分款式名。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页进入字族目录，当前可见十六个完整名字及两项局部，不能据此当作全库字形测试。Sectra详情呈现大幅斜体样张、尖锐衬线和三栏部分款式名，本次没有改文字、下载或购买。免费试用可测试与提案，通常禁止最终文件，学生有特定教学例外；正式项目仍需按地域及Desktop、Web、App用途核授权。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Grilli Type已购买retail字体仅Desktop许可，非美国客户GrilliTypeAG 2020EULA（美国客户另GrilliTypeUSInc 2021EULA，相同用途但地域合同不同）。按购得invoice设备数在单一组织安装，外部客户/不在本址本设备freelancer另须许可；可生成静态/动态图、视频、logo/broadcast及仅PDF/PS/EPS嵌字，不含webfont/App/Device/MSOffice等另licensing。不得改font软件（可outline文字改路径）、转授/出售/分享原字体或转移copyright；许可虽perpetual，可因未纠违约终止/销毁。具体选购字重/设备数与金额未操作。
